decisions.reason: The referral-feedback wording change does not alter the badge catalog; the separate badge decision in the same message is already represented.
The referral-feedback wording change does not alter NFT media rendering; the same message only verifies the existing image-size behavior.
The referral-feedback wording change does not alter badge layout; the independent 4-by-4 layout change from the same message is already represented.
The revised feedback preserves the existing random-holder ticket rule and does not resolve the already-recorded first-mint edge case.
The source changes validation-message wording only and does not request a corresponding FAQ revision; the FAQ already describes random allocation to an existing holder.
The feedback wording restates the existing random-holder commission rule and does not resolve the first-mint destination ambiguity.
The source concerns feedback for absent or invalid codes, not the amount, recipient, timing, or limits of a valid-code referral commission.
The wording change does not alter Small Block ticket issuance, eligibility, weighting, expiration, or post-draw handling.
Mentioning the $500 prize in validation feedback does not change the Small Block prize amount, cadence, eligibility, or funding rules.
The validation-feedback copy change does not alter any NFT metadata identity, counter, badge, or ebook-access attribute.
The source requests an invalid-code message change, not an About-page copy revision.
Changing the invalid-code feedback text does not modify the rule that a valid code must identify an NFT minted before the current purchase.
